name: Bengaluru Cool Down 2019

venue.name: Tiny Tails
venue.address: Sharavanee Square, No 745/AB, 24th Main, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar, VI Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078

information:
**First time participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in Registration Requirements Section.

**Other participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your WCA account.
Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned)
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in Registration Requirements Section.


**Results**
The competition results will take a few days to update on WCA once the competition is over. For live results you can check www.cubecomps.com

**Special Prizes**
Under-8, under-10 & under-12

You can't change the events once the registration closes.
Those who have registered on WCA but have failed to make payment will NOT 
be allowed to participate.


Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
